_comment: Experiment configuration template (config_version 2; version-1 files still load). Copy, rename and edit. Relative paths are resolved against THIS file's directory. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. See annotation_qc/dashboard/README.md.

experiment.title: My species: reference vs predictors
experiment.description: Which prediction files, which reference, and why.

evaluation._comment: evaluation_mode: all | protein_coding | cds_only | canonical. Biotype lists filter genes / transcripts (empty = no filter). genome_mismatch: error | warn | exclude.

policies._comment_policies: Policy ids are free identifiers. Selections: all | longest_cds | canonical. 'canonical' uses the Ensembl_canonical tag; a reference without any tag makes the policy unavailable (the comparator refuses it). Splice-position and intron-length tables exist only for policies with one reference transcript per gene.

references.annotation_release: release or date; write 'unknown' if unknown

annotation_preparation._comment: Optional recorded steps ('decompress', {'name': 'retype_transcript_types', 'types': [...]}). Compressed annotations are read directly by the comparator; no step is needed for them.

scope.label: Whole assembly
scope._comment: type: all | reference_sequence_regions | sequences | regions_file. Decide before comparing tools.

analysis_scopes.label: Main chromosomes
analysis_scopes.description: Defined from sequence names, not from where predictions exist. Reported by the comparator (--analysis-scope) beside the whole comparison.

references.notes: How the assembly identity was checked.

source._comment: Provenance of a renamed or copied file: the original path is kept as written; validation checks sha256.

runs.provenance: Command, date, model weights, masking, evidence used. Leave fields null when unknown: they are shown as unknown.
A second run of the same tool: run_id, not tool, is the identifier; run_label separates them on screen.

runs.label: ToolA run 1 — stop-harmonised
runs._comment: Optional supplementary variant of the same file; listed beside its original and never ranked.

display._comment: Tools listed first, in this order; the other runs follow by descending order_metric for the selected policy and scope.

provenance._comment: Extra implementation registries (annotation-qc benchmark register-build); the packaged registry is always used.

import._comment: Optional. Register completed comparator results without rerunning them. results_dirs: headline results; pilot_dirs: always pilots.
